Google just dropped Gemini 3.7 Flash

it's Google's cheap "workhorse" model, out just 3 weeks after 3.6 Flash. same 1M-token context, built for coding and agents at volume.

where it actually got better:

- web dev: 1588 elo on webdev arena, up from 1538. more complete apps in

a cheap model copies exactly what you feed it, though. a vague brief builds a vague app. want it building like the demos? start here:

https://t.co/74upFt9rJ1

the expensive model isn't the moat anymore. the brief is.

the rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

follow if you're building with cheap models and want the output to look expensive.

DeepSeek just open-sourced its own agent harness, built on 1 idea: everything is a plugin.

it's called DeepSeek Harness (dsh), out now as a v0.1 developer preview. the model, tools, skills, memory, sandbox, loops, and even the UI are all plugins. swap or replace any of them

if you're building your own agents, start here:

https://t.co/FTrr6nlMQN

the rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

follow if you're assembling your own agents and want them to ship real work, not demos.
